Long Lane Deliveries has joined the STEF Group
Since 2024, Longlane Deliveries has joined Langdons, a subsidiary of the STEF Group. This integration strengthens STEF’s presence in the UK by consolidating its transport network in Scotland. It is part of the Group’s strategy to deliver high-performance logistics solutions tailored to the needs of food supply chain stakeholders. By combining our expertise, we now offer a broader range of food transport and logistics services. Our teams are working together to provide long-term support to the agri-food industry and the retail sector across the UK and Europe.
Deliver your fresh and frozen goods across the UK with ease. Our dual-temperature-controlled trailers and real-time tracking provide reliability and transparency every step of the way.
Expand into new markets effortlessly with our cross-border solutions. Backed by the STEF Group, we handle everything from customs to compliance, allowing your products to travel smoothly across Europe.
Maximise product quality with our BRC-accredited warehousing across several UK sites. Our state-of-the-art facilities keep your chilled and frozen products in optimal condition, ready for distribution when you need them.
For over a century, STEF has been evolving to deliver efficient services to its customers. As the European leader in the cold chain, we ensure the daily transport of fresh, frozen, and temperature-sensitive products under optimal conditions of safety, quality, and speed.
Through Langdons and Long Lane Deliveries, STEF strengthens its presence in the UK, consolidating its transport network in Scotland and across the country. This strategic position allows us to offer tailored solutions to meet the needs of food supply chain stakeholders, both nationally and throughout Europe. Our modern infrastructure and combined expertise enable us to provide reliable, high-performance logistics services for the agri-food industry and retail sector.

STEF and Langdons
Langdons is proud to be part of the STEF Group, a European leader in temperature-controlled transport and logistics services.
STEF, the food logistics European leader
For over 100 years, the STEF Group has been at the forefront of temperature-controlled transport, logistics and packaging, serving the food supply chain across Europe.
With operations spanning eight countries, STEF operates over 280 platforms and warehouses, supported by a fleet of 2,700 refrigerated vehicles and 22,000 dedicated employees.
In 2022, STEF achieved a turnover of €4.8 billion, cementing its position as the European leader in its field.
The power of a European transport network
By joining the STEF Group, Langdons has strengthened its ability to provide exceptional temperature-controlled transport and logistics services across the UK and Europe. We combine our local expertise with the Group's international resources, enabling us to deliver flexible and efficient solutions to producers, distributors and consumers.
Together, we share a mission to ensure that food reaches people where and when they need it while prioritising innovation, sustainability and social responsibility.
Shared values driving STEF and Langdons
As part of the STEF Group, we are united by a shared commitment to ensuring safe and sustainable access to food diversity every day. With over 100 years of experience at the heart of the food supply chain, we work together to make sure that millions of people across Europe get the food they need when they need it.
Our employees are driven by four core values:
Carrying out our mission with pride and optimism.
Building trust through listening and commitment.
Upholding high standards and expertise.
Driving innovation and setting ambitious goals.
Sustainability and social responsibility are central to our shared values. Our green initiative focuses on advancing environmentally responsible logistics, with a focus on low-carbon energy adoption and sustainable refrigeration technologies.
Additionally, we actively support social inclusion through programs that promote gender equality, diversity, and professional integration. These efforts highlight our shared dedication to making a positive impact on both the environment and society, reinforcing the values that guide everything we do.
Our logistics experts are ready to help
Langdons is stronger than ever - delivering innovative, reliable and sustainable logistics solutions.
With STEF’s expertise and resources, we continue to set new standards in food distribution, ensuring the safe, efficient and ethical handling of products across the UK and Europe.

National foodservice distributors in the UK, taking chilled and frozen products from factory to table.
Fresh foodservice logistics for your business
When it comes to supplying restaurants, pubs, hotels, and catering businesses, timely and fresh deliveries are critical.
At Langdons, we’re your go-to partner for foodservice distribution and food service logistics, offering reliable and temperature-controlled solutions that meet the demands of your business.
As experienced foodservice distributors, we support businesses across the UK with consistent, nationwide delivery and supply chain expertise.
From chilled and frozen goods to ambient products, your deliveries are handled with care to maintain quality from dispatch through to service.
With nationwide coverage, flexible solutions and BRC-accredited facilities, we’re here to simplify your distribution and help your supply chain run smoothly.
The types of products our foodservice distribution company can store and deliver
We handle a wide range of products to support the diverse needs of foodservice businesses. With temperature-controlled foodservice logistics, we manage everything from chilled items to frozen goods. Here are just some of the types of items we distribute:
Wherever you are, we’ll be there
Serving local customers in busy cities or more remote locations still demands the same level of consistency. Our extensive network ensures that every corner of the UK is covered, allowing your business to run smoothly without worrying about logistics.
We support foodservice distribution across key locations, including London, the Southeast, the Midlands and nationwide, helping businesses connect with reliable foodservice distributors near them.
Explore our locations
Why choose Langdons as your trusted foodservice distributor
At Langdons, we understand that food service logistics require precision, reliability and flexibility. Whether you’re supplying restaurants, catering businesses, hotels, or large-scale food operations, we provide seamless, temperature-controlled foodservice distribution services that keep your supply chain running smoothly.
Specialist temperature-controlled transport
From fresh ingredients to frozen meals, we handle a wide range of foodservice products. Our multi-temperature fleet maintains precise conditions for chilled, frozen, and ambient goods, keeping everything at peak quality from warehouse to kitchen.
Tailored solutions for the foodservice industry
Foodservice supply chains are fast-moving and demand flexibility. We offer scheduled and on-demand deliveries, accommodating everything from bulk orders to last-minute top-ups, so you can keep up with changing customer demands.
Nationwide coverage with industry-leading storage
With BRC-accredited depots across the UK, we reach everywhere from major cities to remote hospitality venues. Our network enables efficient stockholding, just-in-time deliveries and distribution tailored to foodservice schedules.
Real-time tracking & full supply chain visibility
We know reliability is key in foodservice. Our advanced tracking systems let you monitor deliveries in real-time, manage orders with ease and reduce the risk of supply chain disruptions.
Sustainable foodservice logistics
Sustainability is at the core of our operations. We optimise delivery routes to reduce mileage, operate eco-friendly Euro 6 vehicles, and invest in renewable fuel options like HVO-powered lorries at our Luton depot, helping foodservice businesses reduce their carbon footprint.
Seamless national & international distribution
Need to expand your reach? As part of the STEF Group, we offer cross-border logistics, connecting UK foodservice providers with European markets for smooth international supply.
FAQs about foodservice distribution and logistics
What does foodservice distribution actually involve?
Foodservice distribution covers the storage, handling and delivery of food products to hospitality businesses. This includes chilled, frozen and ambient goods moving through temperature-controlled supply chains to restaurants, pubs, hotels and catering providers.
How does foodservice logistics work day-to-day?
Food service logistics brings together warehousing, stock management and transport. Products are stored in regional depots, organised into efficient loads and delivered using scheduled routes or flexible drops, depending on demand.
Do you operate as foodservice distributors near me?
Yes, we provide nationwide foodservice distribution services across the UK, supporting hospitality businesses with consistent, temperature-controlled deliveries.
Our depot network allows us to support businesses in small villages and big cities, including London, Essex, Kent, Surrey, Oxford, Northamptonshire, Milton Keynes, Reading, Slough, Watford and Stevenage, and beyond.
This means you benefit from a partner that understands local delivery requirements while still offering national coverage.
Who typically uses foodservice distribution services?
We support a wide range of businesses, from independent restaurants and pubs to large-scale catering operations, hotel groups and national hospitality brands. Each has different delivery patterns, which is why flexibility in logistics is so important.
Let’s make your foodservice distribution a breeze
If you’re ready to discuss our reliable, flexible and temperature-controlled foodservice distribution and logistics, get in touch. Our team is on hand to explain how we can help streamline your supply chain and keep your deliveries fresh and on time.
